text: player
Radio

"The 21-day soft opening of SAMU Joy Island, the new amusement park that One Han City's famous Samu Corporation has built on an island, will start soon. The first batch of lucky citizens who received invitations will be heading to this magical sea paradise today..."

Outside the car window, the blue sea and sky extend endlessly into the horizon. As one of the lucky citizens proclaimed by the sweet voice on the radio, I can't help but glance emotionally at Osamu Saitou next to me.
You actually bought an island to build an amusement park... You're as amazing as ever, Osamu Saitou.
Osamu Saitou
To be precise, I didn't buy an island.
Hmm?
I bought an archipelago.
SAMU Joy Island is just the first phase of the project. Many more areas of the archipelago need to be developed while preserving the original ecological landscape and local customs.
Can I visit it?

During the soft opening, you have free access to the amusement park, so you can visit wherever you like. When I inspected the place earlier, I noticed many interesting local products that you might like.
That sounds a little too good... Is this another inspection mission I need to complete as the inspector you've invited to assess the soft opening?
I believe that you won't feel like it's a mission with them by your side.
Huh? Who are you talking about?
We're here. Get out of the car. Everyone is waiting for you.
The moist sea breeze embraces me intimately when the door opens, and I see a number of familiar people under the bright sun.
Ichihime
Master! We're over here, nyaa! Everyone has been waiting a long time for you, nyaa!
I'm coming!
I see. Well then, let's explore this fantasy island with our friends from One Han City this summer!
